description:
- Account and profile support is now stable.
- Users can sign in with email or Google.
- Users can skip login and keep using the app normally.
- Firebase sync now supports profile, settings, watch history, and continue watching data.
- The onboarding screen has been cleaned up.
- The account card now shows Login or Logout based on auth state.
